issue.title: Bug: test error message for test_watchdog.py should contain the actual timeout value

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

To help with debugging test failure, the [test error message](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/0355934e7ab78910787da6c2fe754ec7c4507a2d/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L259,L269) for test_watchdog.py should contain the actual timeout value instead of `watchdog_timeout` which is the parameter passed to `arm()`

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Run the sonic-mgmt test on test_watchdog.py on a failing test case
2. Observe the test error message.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior: the test error [message](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/0355934e7ab78910787da6c2fe754ec7c4507a2d/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L258-L259) always contains the timeout passed to watchdog `arm()`

Expected Behavior: the test error message should show the `actual_timeout` returned by the `arm()` method
